crossRefs.note: For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will…
You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance.
Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of the ones doing evil;
He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise.
Don’t let the foot of pride come against me. Don’t let the hand of the wicked drive me away.
Blessed is the man who makes Yahweh his trust, and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn away to lies.
God, the proud have risen up against me. A company of violent men have sought after my soul, and they don’t hold regard…
then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.
The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me.
Now I know that Yahweh is greater than all gods because of the way that they treated people arrogantly.”
But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of the ones doing evil;
They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper’s poison is under their lips.
You will be hidden from the scourge of the tongue, neither will you be afraid of destruction when it comes.
Let’s walk properly, as in the day; not in reveling and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and lustful acts, and…
For I am afraid that by any means, when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by…
idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,
he is conceited, knowing nothing, but obsessed with arguments, disputes, and word battles, from which come envy…
So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!
And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets…
But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don’t boast and don’t lie against the truth.

translations.web: In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man. You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the strife of tongues.
translations.bsb: You hide them in the secret place of Your presence from the schemes of men. You conceal them in Your shelter from accusing tongues.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.
translations.asv: In the covert of thy presence wilt thou hide them from the plottings of man: Thou wilt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.
